$comment: The producer listing (decision 0003). A survey page links a public report only when the delivery's producer is listed here, the report names one of that producer's systems, and the report's URL is https on that system's host. Changed only by pull request; see producers/README.md.

producers.name: Watchdog
producers.interests: Watchdog was a commercial engine of Canine Development ApS, retired on 2026-11-04 (decision 0007). Its deliveries stay as they were signed. The Initiative's acting maintainer runs Canine Development.
